name: api-failure-monitor
description: Runtime circuit-breaker preflight: probes one or more x402/MPP endpoints using selat-pay --probe-only to confirm live 402 signals and live prices before launching a multi-step paid pipeline. Halts and reroutes on any non-402 response, timeout, dead URL, or probe error.

targetUrl.description: x402/MPP endpoint to probe, e.g. https://serpapi.mpp.tempo.xyz/search

method.description: HTTP method for the probe (GET or POST). Passed to selat-pay --probe-only.

chain.description: Chain flag forwarded to selat-pay --probe-only. Probing is chain-independent and free; this satisfies selat-pay's required --chain argument.

timeoutSeconds.description: Probe timeout in seconds. Triggers HALT_AND_REROUTE on expiry.
